target_contract.input: validated tool arguments plus separate trusted runtime context
target_contract.output: validated common response envelope narrowed to selected tool result
target_contract.credentials: runtime-only service credentials; CallCraft user_id is not Teman Bule actor_user_id
target_contract.request_payload: explicit schema-bound mapping; no automatic context-token interpolation into prompts
target_contract.timeout: registry timeout bounded by invocation deadline
target_contract.error: normalize transport/vendor/domain failures; only backend-verified succeeded status permits success claim

activation_gates: Verify installed Langflow/LFX version and exported component format
Verify input/output mapping against actual CallCraft execution fixtures
Verify credentials and private payloads absent from exports, logs and debug traces
Disable implicit file heuristics for domain tool arguments unless explicitly declared by schema
Validate schema and tool authorization before execution
